goal: Generate and execute one bounded offline FocusForge candidate under the Codex capability brief to measure goal fidelity and logical structure without an external API call.
acceptance_criteria: The candidate is isolated, labelled offline_mock_provider, and makes zero external API calls.
The nine named CLI commands map to nine concrete callable handlers and the domain includes WorkItem, JSONRepository, and WorkspaceService.
The project contains at most eight primary source files and five test files.
Pytest and a direct CLI smoke flow prove CRUD, query, lifecycle, summary, import/export, corruption, and duplicate-ID behavior.
The experiment records an evidence-backed comparison with the 87-request failed baseline and does not claim formal delivery PASS.

quality_metrics.measure: requested domain behavior implemented as executable interfaces
quality_metrics.target: 9/9 callable handlers and all frozen smoke behaviors pass
quality_metrics.method: AST/interface inspection, pytest, and direct CLI execution

quality_metrics.measure: offline generation size and external usage
quality_metrics.target: at most 8 primary source files, at most 5 test files, and 0 external API calls
separate demonstrated project behavior from unmeasured Provider token and generation performance
quality_metrics.method: iteration review and runtime evidence inspection

prevention: Apply EXP-CGKN-LIBRARIAN-001 by using only the validated 2444-character Provider-facing brief projection.
Apply EXP-CGKN-QUALITY-001 by marking the candidate as an offline experiment rather than formal Provider or delivery evidence.
Freeze command-to-handler, domain, file-count, and behavior acceptance before creating source files.
assurance: Inspect that every command dispatch target is callable and backed by a service method.
Review source and test counts against the supervisor limits.
control: Run compileall and pytest with third-party plugin autoload disabled.
Run a fresh CLI flow in a temporary workspace.
Validate the management record and inspect the generated experiment manifest.
improvement: Use the offline result to decide whether a capped real Provider A/B run is justified.

interface_expectations: The supervisor brief remains advisory context; the experiment generator identity is offline_mock_provider.
The experiment never enters local_packager or the public delivery gate.
Stable JSON errors and exit codes make failure behavior testable.

feedback: The isolated candidate implemented 9/9 callable command handlers with 6 primary source files and 3 test files, staying below the supervisor limits.
Compileall, pytest, unittest, and a direct temporary-workspace CLI flow passed and covered the frozen functional and storage behaviors.
Compared with the failed baseline's 0/9 handlers and non-executable generic orchestration, the offline candidate demonstrates a positive logical-structure and runtime effect.
Because the reviewed Provider was not called, Provider token savings and real Provider generation quality remain NOT_EVALUATED.

worked: Freezing the domain interfaces and command-to-handler mapping before source creation prevented the generic-stage substitution seen in the failed baseline.
The five-item guidance projection was sufficient to produce a compact, executable standard-library project without loading the original oversized test history.
Behavior-focused test grouping covered the full acceptance flow with three test files instead of nineteen planned test leaves.
did_not_work: The first standalone smoke evidence script read the post-delete count after replace import; the evidence script was corrected and rerun immediately, while the project behavior itself remained passing.
The experiment cannot measure Provider prompt tokens because zero external Provider requests were intentionally made.
experiments: If the user authorizes a paid A/B run, feed the same brief into the reviewed Provider route with a hard ceiling of twelve requests and compare first-pass handler coverage, test pass rate, and recorded usage.
